{{PAGENAME}} is a female NPC who is seen talking to a Light & Energy Science student about the sound of mushrooms.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Canduras:''' Have you ever heard the sound mushrooms make?
:'''Lan:''' Huh? Mushroom sounds?
:'''Canduras:''' And Lichen. And Snowfluff Seals...
:'''Canduras:''' The Overtonic Society has a frequency extraction device that can capture their voices.
:'''Canduras:''' The mushrooms make really sharp, high-pitched sounds, almost like they're screaming.
:'''Lan:''' Yeah, they make the same sound when you toss them in a frying pan...
{{Dialogue End}}

==Trivia==
*Placing items, mainly organic items, to a modular synthesizer to create sounds. A well known example being the [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-hlQHYtncww Pink Oyster Mushroom].
